title: Bengal BJP chief seeks fresh SIR, says earlier exercise incomplete
description:
BJP MP and West Bengal unit president Samik Bhattacharya on Saturday sought a fresh SIR of electoral rolls in the state, claiming that the exercise conducted ahead of the Assembly elections was incomplete.
He alleged that more names could have been deleted from the voter list had the officials involved in the exercise, from block development officers to anganwadi workers, and BJP workers not been intimidated.
"The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) held in West Bengal is incomplete," Bhattacharya said.
"Speaking on behalf of the BJP, I want to say that there is a need for a fresh SIR in the state," he said at the inaugural meeting of a trade union of contractual workers at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport here.
He pointed out that the Assembly elections in Bihar were held after the SIR of electoral rolls in the state, while no such exercise was conducted before the polls in Haryana and Delhi, where the BJP emerged victorious.
